purpose: Bind a Factory-approved release to one isolated customer deployment without storing raw credentials or granting implicit external authority.
isolationRules: Every action must carry the same customerId and tenantId as the deployment profile.
The namespace must be customer-scoped and may not be shared across customers.
An integration may execute only actions explicitly present in its allowedActions list.
Cross-tenant reads or writes fail closed.
credentialRules: Raw passwords, API keys, OAuth tokens, private keys and client secrets are prohibited from the profile.
Integrations store credentialRef only; secret material remains in the approved runtime secret store/provider.
Credential connection does not grant action authority.
authorityRules: CONNECTED_SHADOW may process real inputs but external actions are prohibited.
APPROVAL_GATED may prepare protected actions but execution remains blocked until the action carries its required approval/permit evidence.
BOUNDED_LIVE permits only explicitly allowlisted actions and does not bypass SAFE preflight.
No deployment inherits permissions, approvals, credentials or budget from another customer or Factory Run.
Permission changes, destructive actions and deployment-scope expansion require separate explicit authorization.
